instructions: Beat the eggs in a bowl with a pinch of salt.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a pan. Pour in eggs, scramble until just set. Remove and set aside.
Heat remaining oil. Add tomatoes, cook until soft, about 3 minutes.
Add sugar and salt, stir well.
Return eggs to the pan. Toss everything together for 1 minute.
Garnish with green onions. Serve hot with rice.
